summary: Players build factories to produce containers, then set prices and sail those containers across the sea to sell at auction, operating within a closed economy where money circulates only among the players rather than from a bank. Secretly dealt container value cards mean each player privately values certain goods more than others, shaping negotiation and speculation around every sale.

interaction.kind: closed-economy auctions and negotiation between players
interaction.detail: Because the economy is closed, every auction, sale, and loan moves money and containers directly from one player to another rather than through a bank, so prices depend heavily on what rivals are willing to pay, even though each player's own factories and production are managed individually.

scoring.how_you_win: Players profit by producing, pricing, and selling containers for more than they cost to build and ship, and the player who accumulates the most money ends up ahead.
